Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR CARBIDE TIPPED CHUCKING 
REAMERS WITH PARALLEL SHANKS 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and requirements for carbide tipped chucking reamers with 
parallel shanks. 

2. Types — Chucking reamers shall be of two types: 

Type A — Without tenon, and 
Type B — With tenon. 

3. Dimensions— Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Tolerances — The tolerances on cutting length and overall length shall be as given below: 

All dimensions in millimetres. 



Over 


Up to and 
Including 


Tolerances 


6 


30 


±10

120 


±1-5 


120 


315 


±20 



5. General Requirements 

5.1 Bevel Lead Angle — 45**, shall be concentric with the diameter of reamer within 0*03 mm. 

5.2 Back Taper — Reamers shall be provided with back taper on the cutting edge diameter and the 
amount of taper shall be within the limits of tolerance on the cutting edge diameter. 

5.3 Flutes, unless otherwise specified shall be right-hand cutting with straight flutes. 

5.4 The carbide tips shall be of range of application K10 according to 13:2428-1964 'Application 
of carbides for machining, ranges of application and colour code'. 

5.5 Carbide tips shall be according to IS : 9327-1979 'Dimensions for carbide tips for reamers, core 
drills, end mills and slot milling cutters '. 

5.6 For requirements not covered in this standard, it shall conform to the requirements of IS : 10923- 
1984 ' Technical supply conditions for carbide tipped and solid carbide reamers '. 

5.7 Dimensions for driving tenons shall be according to 13:5360-1969 'Dimensions for driving 
tenons '. 

6. Sampling -— The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be In accordance with IS : 7778-1975 
' Methods for sampling small tools '. 

7. Designation 

7.1 A carbide tipped chucking reamer with parallel shank of Type A having diameter G('=12mm, 
carbide tip of range of application K10, conforming to this standard and suitable for a hole with 
tolerance H8 shall be designated as: 



CT Reamer A 12 



IS : 10884 K10

7.1.1 When the reamer is required for a hole with tolerance other than H8, an appropriate hole 
tolerance shall be included in the designation after size. 

Example: 

A carbide tipped chucking reamer with parallel shank of Type A having diameter (/ -» 12 mm, 
carbide tip of range of application K10, conforming to this standard and suitable for a hole 
with tolerance H9 shall be designated as: 

CT Reamer A 12 ( Hole H9 ) IS : 10884 K10 

8. ISI Certification IMarking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from DiNBOSO- 
1979 ' Maschinen-Reibahlen mit Zylinderschaft mit Schneidplatten aus Hartmetall mit Kurzem 
Schneidteir. (Machine-reamers with parallel shanks with carbide tips, with short cutting part), 
issued by Deutsches Institut fur Normung ( DIN ).
